convert_lightglue_checkpoint: convert a LightGlue checkpoint from the original repository to Hugging Face transformers format
run_lightglue_model_verification: run the LightGlue model and verify its outputs match expected values for image matching tasks
split_lightglue_weights: split concatenated Wqkv and to_qk weight matrices into separate q, k, v projection layers for the transformer
add_keypoint_detector_weights: add SuperPoint keypoint detector weights to the LightGlue state dict for unified keypoint matching
write_lightglue_image_processor: write and save a LightGlue image processor configuration with optional grayscale preprocessing
